messages:
Jordan: @here Heads-up: planned regional failover + KV-prefix eviction dry run this Thu 02:00-03:00 UTC. Purpose is to validate routing fallbacks and cache warmup after the control-plane rollout. Expected impact: brief p99 spike, small % of 5xxs (target <2%), short tail for a subset of prefixes. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/rb/kv-failover-dryrun (please read before the window).

Maria: ACK. I'll own dashboards (p99, error-rate, per-route qps). Will set alerts to 1.5x baseline for the window.

Alex: Can you paste the rollback triggers? Will be on call.

Jordan: Rollback triggers (short):
- sustained p99 > 2x baseline for >10min AND error-rate >3%
- >5% global 5xx for 5m
- any customer-facing 503 surge not explained by experiment
If triggered, global-routing rollback takes priority, then cache-warmup abort.
Full playbook in runbook link above.

Kevin: Traffic plan: we'll shift traffic by region in 4 waves (10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%), 5m between waves. Each wave validated against canary metrics. If fail, we pause and revert last step.

Tanya: Suggest we stagger edge-pool drains by AZ to avoid correlated tail. I can patch the staging job to pick different AZs.

Jordan: Good call Tanya — implement staggered drains. Kevin - update the traffic script to emit progress markers to #release-war-room so oncall can follow.

Maria: Few quick checks I'll run 10m before start:
- curl -sS https://health.redwood.example/v1/ready | jq .status
- grafana: p99 per-route panel -> set lookback to 30m
- verify KV cache hit-rate and prefix warmup metrics
Snippet for readiness check:```bash
# from bastion
curl -fS -H "Authorization: Bearer $MONITOR_TOKEN" https://health.redwood.example/v1/ready || exit 1
```

Alex: deploy-bot created the maintenance ticket and annotated the affected models. ticket: https://tickets.internal/INC-1234 (deploy-bot message below).

deploy-bot: scheduled maintenance created: INC-1234 — KV-prefix eviction dry run — Thu 02:00-03:00 UTC. Owner: Jordan.

sre-bot: reminder: oncall rotation for Thu: Maria -> Alex -> Kevin. Pager schedule link: https://oncall.internal/schedule.

Kevin: Quick note on SLOs: we'll temporarily widen the p99 alert thresholds for the window (documented in the ticket). This is only to avoid noisy alerts; escalation rules remain the same.

Tanya: I'll watch edge pool drain logs and surface any unexpected pod restart patterns. If we see abrupt container OOMs, we abort.

Jordan: Post-run actions:
- 30m post: sanity sweep and aggregated metrics dump
- 2h post: incident summary (if >1% customer impact)
- 24h post: follow-up retro in ops sync if any regressions

Maria: I'll stream the dashboard to the release room during the run and post snapshots after each wave.

Alex: ACK. I'll prep the rollback playbook snippet in the ticket and be ready to execute if needed. :thumbsup:

Jordan: Thanks all. If you cannot make the window, ping me now (or swap with oncall). Otherwise I'll post a final preflight checklist 30m before the start.

sre-bot: automated note: this thread will be cross-posted to #incidents if error-rate > 3% during the window.

Tanya: One last ask — can we include a quick flamegraph capture step in the runbook for any models that show tail latency? I can add that.

Jordan: Yes please add: `pprof` capture + a short `perf` snapshot step (link to kit in runbook).

Maria: prepping dashboards now, will post snapshots to thread 15m pre-run.

Alex: prepping my keyboard. :)

Jordan: End of thread for planning. Will post preflight and then live updates during the window. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
